OTC Clinical Encounter

Interview the patient, find the red flags, decide, then dispense and counsel. The patient only tells you what you ask.

4 patients100 points eachRed flag scoring
Educational simulation. Not a substitute for clinical assessment or local protocols.
Characters: “Transformers The Game Sam And Mikaela” by Pipogame (Sketchfab), CC BY 4.0.

How to play

4 stages per patient
  • 1Interview: tap questions. Findings appear on the card. Irrelevant questions cost patience.
  • 2Assess: decide if OTC is appropriate, needs caution, further assessment, or urgent referral.
  • 3Treat: choose the OTC option, or the right referral action.
  • 4Counsel: choose the most important advice.

Score: Clinical assessment 30% · Medication 30% · Counseling 20% · Safety and referral 20%. Dangerous choices are flagged as critical errors.
